# A contact is real after it answers

Every onboarding gap that later cost hours traced to a contact or channel copied from
the contract and never exercised. The dry-run exchange is the whole point of
onboarding: a support address that answers in a day, an escalation contact who has
actually heard of us, and a channel that routes where the vendor said it would. Treat
an unanswered dry-run as a failed onboarding step, not as a formality to note and
move past.
